create_encoder: create an Encoder instance with a given number of inputs and optional tied weights
run_encoder_forward: run the Encoder forward pass on a batch of multi-view image tensors
build_vae_encoding: build a variational encoding pipeline that outputs mu and logstd latent variables
test_kldiv_loss: test the KL divergence loss computation by passing kldiv in the losslist argument
review_encoder_architecture: review the Encoder class convolutional downsampling layers and linear latent output heads
